description: A fund manager's 13F holdings for a quarter (latest by default): positions by value with portfolio weights, the total checked against the filing's cover page, and what changed since the previous quarter (new, exited, added, reduced).

compare.description: Also compare with the previous quarter's filing; default true.

manager.description: The 13F filer: name ("Berkshire Hathaway", "Bridgewater Associates"), ticker or CIK.

period.description: Quarter end, for example 2026-06-30; default the latest filed.

top.description: Most positions to list, by value; default 25.

name: fund_holdings

outputSchema.description: rows are positions by value with weights; changes_since compares with the previous quarter.

title: Fund holdings (13F)
